name: Wildfire, Fuel Load, Fire Spread & Post-Fire Ecology Runtime
design_rules: wildfire ignition depends on fuel, moisture and heat
wind biases spread direction and increases ember transport
wetland and saturated cells act as natural fire breaks
fire consumes available fuel instead of burning indefinitely
burned cells transition into post-fire recovery rather than static char decals
ash can temporarily improve fertility while exposed soil increases erosion risk
fauna pressure may increase near active fire but population is not deleted arbitrarily
wildfire never uses emissive or glow feedback as a gameplay indicator
